segments.text: A baby who was abandoned in front of Aoba clinic.
Kazuki Hana's split personality she real-booted in order to help her live a more fulfilling high school life.
She's actually a real split personality; the original Kazuki's powers don't have anything to do with her existence.

A diligent 3rd-year high school student. President of the Newspaper Club. His parents died during the earthquake six years ago. Since then, he has taken shelter in the mobile home near Miyashita Public Park.
One of the heroines. 2nd-year high school student and member of the newspaper club. Childhood friend of Takuru.
One of the heroines. 3rd-year high school student and the vice president of the newspaper club. Her parents died in the Great Shibuya earthquake. She comes from the same orphanage as Takuru.

actors.creditedName: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美
actors.name: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

segments.text: One of the heroines. A 2nd-year high school student and a president of the literary club. She is a fashion-conscious modern type high school girl.
One of the heroines. A childish-looking 14-year-old, she's actually quite composed young lady. She has almost no ability with mobile phones, computers or other electronics.
One of the heroines. 1st-year high school student and a member of the Newspaper Club. Silent otaku girl with extreme nearsightedness. The club members treat her like a little sister.

3rd-year high school student. Never attends any lessons and always wears a lab coat. She works as a neuroscientist at the American Viktor Chondria university. She has flown to Shibuya in order to research the Chaos Child Syndrome.
Childhood friend of Nono who allegedly died in the earthquake six years ago. Everything about her is hidden behind a shroud of a mystery.

segments.text: Student Council member. Friend of Nono.
Ever since his childhood, he has held a deep-seated hatred for Minamisawa Senri, and an obsessive love for Kurusu Nono.
Teacher at Hekihou Academy. Adviser of the Newspaper Club.
Member of the Newspaper Club and Takuru's friend.
A detective who is given charge of the case of the Return of the New Generation Madness.
Yui and her younger brother live at the Aoba Dorm with Takuru and Nono. She is very protective of her brother.
A medical doctor in Aoba Clinic and the foster father of Takuru, Nono, Yuuto and Yui.
He is a homeless Shibuya resident, and a close friend to Miyashiro Takuru. Almost always drunk, he serves as a comedic relief during serious times.
